description: Search the medical concept database for observations matching a phrase (autocomplete). Engine API: GET /search.

dev_mode.description: If true, mark the request as test traffic → sends the `Dev-Mode: true` header.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 8).

model_id.description: Optional medical model id → sent as the `Model-Id` request header.

phrase.description: Text phrase to match against concept names/synonyms (required).

types.description: Restrict results to these concept types.

name: infermedica_search_concepts
title: Search concepts
